roleDetails:
I am Sajan, a Full Stack Architect who designs the whole stack, not just the surface. I turn complex ideas into reliable, high-performance digital products.

With deep engineering experience, I specialize in architecting scalable microservices, deploying robust cloud infrastructures, and crafting pixel-perfect, highly responsive frontend interfaces. My expertise is anchored by advanced knowledge of React, Node.js, Java Spring Boot, AWS, and modern web technologies.

I build systems that don't just work—they scale effortlessly. From designing complex CI/CD pipelines to optimizing database performance and ensuring seamless UI/UX, my approach is entirely holistic. I believe in writing code that is as elegant under the hood as it is on the screen.

Having engineered solutions for fast-paced tech startups and enterprise environments, I thrive on solving the hardest technical problems. I don't just write code; I engineer scalable digital systems that drive actual business growth.

experience.note: A fast-paced tech company specializing in scalable cloud solutions and enterprise web applications.

points: Architected and deployed highly scalable microservices using Node.js and Spring Boot, reducing API latency by 35%.
Led the frontend team in migrating legacy applications to React and TypeScript, improving development velocity.
Integrated AWS S3 and Google Cloud Drive APIs for seamless cloud asset management.
Established CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions and Docker, ensuring smooth and rapid deployments.

experience.note: An award-winning digital agency delivering bespoke web experiences and e-commerce platforms.

points: Developed interactive and dynamic UI components using React, HTML5, and CSS3.
Optimized web applications for maximum speed, achieving a 95+ score on Google Lighthouse.
Collaborated closely with UX/UI designers to translate Figma mockups into pixel-perfect code.
Maintained and queried MySQL databases for efficient data retrieval.
